stories.title: 画皮 · The Painted Skin

cards.title: 01. 书生遇美女 | The Scholar Meets a Girl
cards.sentence: 一天晚上，王生在路上遇到了一个年轻的女孩。
cards.pinyin: Yì tiān wǎnshang, Wáng shēng zài lùshang yùdào le yí ge niánqīng de nǚhái.
cards.translation: One evening, Wang the scholar met a young girl on the road.

vocabList.translation: to run into; to come across

cards.title: 02. 路边的哭声 | Crying by the Road
cards.sentence: 她一个人坐在路边哭，看起来很难过。
cards.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zuò zài lùbiān kū, kàn qǐlái hěn nánguò.
cards.translation: She sat alone by the road, crying. She looked very sad.

cards.title: 03. 无家可归 | Nowhere to Go
cards.sentence: 她说：“家里人要把我卖给别人，我只好跑出来了。”
cards.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Jiālǐ rén yào bǎ wǒ mài gěi biérén, wǒ zhǐhǎo pǎo chūlái le.”
cards.translation: She said, “My family wanted to sell me to someone else, so I had no choice but to run away.”

vocabList.translation: to have no choice but to

cards.title: 04. 带回家 | A Stranger at Home
cards.sentence: 王生很担心她，就带她回了自己的家。
cards.pinyin: Wáng shēng hěn dānxīn tā, jiù dài tā huí le zìjǐ de jiā.
cards.translation: Wang worried about her, so he took her to his own home.

cards.title: 05. 窗外的秘密 | The Secret at the Window
cards.sentence: 那天夜里，王生怎么也睡不着，他走到女孩的房间外面，从窗户往里看。
cards.pinyin: Nà tiān yè lǐ, Wáng shēng zěnme yě shuì bù zháo, tā zǒudào nǚhái de fángjiān wàimian, cóng chuānghu wǎng lǐ kàn.
cards.translation: That night, Wang couldn't fall asleep. He walked to the outside of the girl's room and looked in through the window.

cards.title: 06. 真面目 | The Real Face
cards.sentence: 屋里坐着的不是女孩，而是一个很可怕的鬼！
cards.pinyin: Wū lǐ zuòzhe de bú shì nǚhái, ér shì yí ge hěn kěpà de guǐ!
cards.translation: The one sitting in the room was not a girl, but a terrifying ghost!

cards.title: 07. 画皮 | Painting the Skin
cards.sentence: 桌子上放着一张人皮，鬼拿着笔，在人皮上画漂亮的脸。
cards.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yì zhāng rénpí, guǐ názhe bǐ, zài rénpí shàng huà piàoliang de liǎn.
cards.translation: A human skin lay on the table. The ghost held a brush and painted a pretty face on it.

cards.title: 08. 逃跑 | Running Away
cards.sentence: 王生吓坏了，连衣服都没穿好，就跑了出去。
cards.pinyin: Wáng shēng xià huài le, lián yīfu dōu méi chuān hǎo, jiù pǎo le chūqù.
cards.translation: Wang was scared out of his wits. He ran out without even putting his clothes on properly.

cards.title: 09. 找道士 | Looking for a Priest
cards.sentence: 他不敢回家，想去找一位有名的道士帮忙。
cards.pinyin: Tā bù gǎn huí jiā, xiǎng qù zhǎo yí wèi yǒumíng de dàoshi bāngmáng.
cards.translation: He did not dare go home. He wanted to find a famous Taoist priest to help him.

cards.title: 10. 道士的办法 | The Priest's Plan
cards.sentence: 道士给了他一面镜子，告诉他：“看到她，就用镜子照她。”
cards.pinyin: Dàoshi gěi le tā yí miàn jìngzi, gàosu tā: “Kàndào tā, jiù yòng jìngzi zhào tā.”
cards.translation: The priest gave him a mirror and told him, “When you see her, shine the mirror on her.”

cards.title: 11. 面对 | Face to Face
cards.sentence: 王生回到家，虽然很害怕，还是拿起镜子，照向那个鬼。
cards.pinyin: Wáng shēng huí dào jiā, suīrán hěn hàipà, háishi ná qǐ jìngzi, zhào xiàng nà ge guǐ.
cards.translation: Wang went home. Although he was very afraid, he still picked up the mirror and shone it on the ghost.

cards.title: 12. 结局 | The Ending
cards.sentence: 镜子一照，鬼变成了一张旧人皮，家里又安静了。
cards.pinyin: Jìngzi yí zhào, guǐ biàn chéng le yì zhāng jiù rénpí, jiālǐ yòu ānjìng le.
cards.translation: As soon as the mirror shone on it, the ghost turned into an old human skin, and the house was quiet again.

stories.intro: A scholar takes a lonely girl home and learns she is not what she seems. Pu Songling's best-known ghost story.
stories.introZh: 王生带一个女孩回家，可是她不是人。

stories.title: 崂山道士 · The Taoist of Mount Laoshan

cards.title: 01. 富家子弟 | A Spoiled Son
cards.sentence: 王七是一个有钱人家的孩子，每天什么都不用做。
cards.pinyin: Wáng Qī shì yī gè yǒu qián rén jiā de hái zi，měi tiān shén me dōu bù yòng zuò。
cards.translation: Wang Qi was the son of a wealthy family; he had nothing to do every day.

cards.title: 02. 听说法术 | Tales of Magic
cards.sentence: 有一天，他听说崂山上有一位道士，会很多神奇的法术。
cards.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān，tā tīng shuō láo shān shàng yǒu yī wèi dào shì，huì hěn duō shén qí de fǎ shù。
cards.translation: One day, he heard that on Mount Laoshan there lived a Taoist priest who knew many magical skills.

cards.title: 03. 上山拜师 | Off to the Mountain
cards.sentence: 王七很想去学，于是收拾行李，一个人上了山。
cards.pinyin: Wáng Qī hěn xiǎng qù xué，yú shì shōu shí xíng lǐ，yī gè rén shàng le shān。
cards.translation: Wang Qi really wanted to learn, so he packed his bags and went up the mountain alone.

cards.title: 04. 喝酒聊天 | Drinking and Chatting
cards.sentence: 到了山上，他看见道士正和几个徒弟一起喝酒、聊天。
cards.pinyin: Dào le shān shàng，tā kàn jiàn dào shì zhèng hé jǐ gè tú dì yī qǐ hē jiǔ、liáo tiān。
cards.translation: At the mountain, he saw the Taoist drinking and chatting with several disciples.

cards.title: 05. 跪求拜师 | Begging to Learn
cards.sentence: 王七跪下请求：“请您教我法术吧！”
cards.pinyin: Wáng Qī guì xià qǐng qiú：“qǐng nín jiāo wǒ fǎ shù ba！”
cards.translation: Wang Qi knelt and begged, "Please teach me magic!"

cards.title: 06. 先砍柴 | Chop Wood First
cards.sentence: 道士答应了，却先让他每天上山砍柴。
cards.pinyin: Dào shì dá yīng le，què xiān ràng tā měi tiān shàng shān kǎn chái。
cards.translation: The Taoist agreed, but first made him chop wood on the mountain every day.

cards.title: 07. 辛苦一月 | A Hard Month
cards.sentence: 一个月过去了，王七的手磨出了血，累得走不动路。
cards.pinyin: Yī gè yuè guò qù le，Wáng Qī de shǒu mó chū le xuè，lèi de zǒu bù dòng lù。
cards.translation: A month passed; Wang Qi's hands bled from the work, and he was so tired he could not walk.

cards.title: 08. 想回家 | Wanting to Quit
cards.sentence: 他心里想：“学法术这么辛苦，我还是回家吧。”
cards.pinyin: Tā xīn lǐ xiǎng：“xué fǎ shù zhè me xīn kǔ，wǒ hái shì huí jiā ba。”
cards.translation: He thought to himself, "Learning magic is so hard; I had better go home."

cards.title: 09. 穿墙术 | The Wall-Walking Skill
cards.sentence: 道士看出他想走，就说：“我教你一个穿墙的本领。”
cards.pinyin: Dào shì kàn chū tā xiǎng zǒu，jiù shuō：“wǒ jiào nǐ yī gè chuān qiáng de běn lǐng。”
cards.translation: The Taoist saw he wanted to leave and said, "I will teach you a skill to pass through walls."

cards.title: 10. 真的穿过了 | It Works!
cards.sentence: 道士念了几句咒语，王七真的穿过了墙壁，没有受伤。
cards.pinyin: Dào shì niàn le jǐ jù zhòu yǔ，Wáng Qī zhēn de chuān guò le qiáng bì，méi yǒu shòu shāng。
cards.translation: The Taoist chanted a few spells, and Wang Qi really passed through the wall without getting hurt.

cards.title: 11. 回家炫耀 | Showing Off
cards.sentence: 王七高兴地回家，对妻子说：“我会法术了，看我穿墙！”
cards.pinyin: Wáng Qī gāo xīng dì huí jiā，duì qī zi shuō：“wǒ huì fǎ shù le，kàn wǒ chuān qiáng！”
cards.translation: Wang Qi went home happily and said to his wife, "I know magic now — watch me go through the wall!"

cards.title: 12. 撞了满头包 | A Bumpy End
cards.sentence: 他闭上眼睛朝墙冲过去，结果一头撞在墙上，肿了个大包。
cards.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎn jīng cháo qiáng chōng guò qù，jié guǒ yī tóu zhuàng zài qiáng shàng，zhǒng le gè dà bāo。
cards.translation: He closed his eyes and rushed at the wall — but ended up bumping his head on it, leaving a big lump.

stories.intro: A rich, lazy young man goes up a mountain to learn magic, but he hates hard work. A funny story about patience.
stories.introZh: 王七想学法术，可是他不想辛苦。

stories.title: 种梨 · Planting a Pear

cards.title: 01. 叫卖甜梨 | Selling Pears
cards.sentence: 集市上，一个卖梨的人正在大声叫卖，梨又大又甜。
cards.pinyin: Jí shì shàng，yī gè mài lí de rén zhèng zài dà shēng jiào mài，lí yòu dà yòu tián。
cards.translation: At the market, a pear seller was shouting his wares; his pears were big and sweet.

cards.title: 02. 讨梨被拒 | A Refused Request
cards.sentence: 一位穿得破旧的道士走过来，说：“给我一个梨吧。”
cards.pinyin: Yī wèi chuān dé pò jiù de dào shì zǒu guò lái，shuō：“gěi wǒ yī gè lí ba。”
cards.translation: A shabbily dressed Taoist came over and said, "Give me a pear."

cards.title: 03. 小气商人 | The Stingy Seller
cards.sentence: 卖梨的人很生气，摇头说：“不卖！一个也不给。”
cards.pinyin: Mài lí de rén hěn shēng qì，yáo tóu shuō：“bù mài！yī gè yě bù gěi。”
cards.translation: The pear seller was angry and shook his head, "Not for sale! I won't give you one."

cards.title: 04. 旁人相助 | A Kind Bystander
cards.sentence: 旁边的人看不过去，花钱买了一个梨送给道士。
cards.pinyin: Páng biān de rén kàn bù guò qù，huā qián mǎi le yī gè lí sòng gěi dào shì。
cards.translation: A bystander, unable to bear it, paid for a pear and gave it to the Taoist.

cards.title: 05. 种下梨核 | Planting the Core
cards.sentence: 道士吃完梨，把梨核种在了地上的土里。
cards.pinyin: Dào shì chī wán lí，bǎ lí hé zhǒng zài le dì shàng de tǔ lǐ。
cards.translation: After eating the pear, the Taoist planted the core in the soil.

cards.title: 06. 瞬间长树 | A Tree Appears
cards.sentence: 奇怪的事发生了：小苗很快长成了一棵大树。
cards.pinyin: Qí guài de shì fā shēng le：xiǎo miáo hěn kuài zhǎng chéng le yī kē dà shù。
cards.translation: Something strange happened: the small sprout quickly grew into a big tree.

cards.title: 07. 开花结果 | Blossoms and Fruit
cards.sentence: 树上开满了白色的花，接着又结出了很多梨。
cards.pinyin: Shù shàng kāi mǎn le bái sè de huā，jiē zhe yòu jiē chū le hěn duō lí。
cards.translation: The tree was covered with white blossoms, and then bore many pears.

cards.title: 08. 分梨给大家 | Sharing the Pears
cards.sentence: 道士把梨摘下来，分给看热闹的人吃，大家都很高兴。
cards.pinyin: Dào shì bǎ lí zhāi xià lái，fēn gěi kàn rè nào de rén chī，dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xīng。
cards.translation: The Taoist picked the pears and shared them with the onlookers; everyone was happy.

cards.title: 09. 梨不见了 | The Pears Vanish
cards.sentence: 这时，卖梨人车上的梨，正一个一个地变少。
cards.pinyin: Zhè shí，mài lí rén chē shàng de lí，zhèng yī gè yī gè dì biàn shǎo。
cards.translation: At that moment, the pears on the seller's cart were disappearing one by one.

cards.title: 10. 车空轮坏 | Empty Cart, Broken Wheel
cards.sentence: 卖梨人回头一看，车已经空了，轮子也坏了。
cards.pinyin: Mài lí rén huí tóu yī kàn，chē yǐ jīng kōng le，lún zi yě huài le。
cards.translation: The seller looked back — the cart was empty, and the wheel was broken too.

cards.title: 11. 原来如此 | The Truth
cards.sentence: 原来，道士分给大家的梨，就是卖梨人车上的那些。
cards.pinyin: Yuán lái，dào shì fēn gěi dà jiā de lí，jiù shì mài lí rén chē shàng de nà xiē。
cards.translation: It turned out the pears the Taoist gave everyone were exactly those from the seller's cart.

cards.title: 12. 又气又悔 | Anger and Regret
cards.sentence: 卖梨人又气又后悔，知道自己太小气了。
cards.pinyin: Mài lí rén yòu qì yòu hòu huǐ，zhī dào zì jǐ tài xiǎo qì le。
cards.translation: The seller was both angry and regretful, realizing he had been too stingy.

stories.intro: A poor priest asks a pear seller for just one pear. What happens next teaches the seller a lesson.
stories.introZh: 道士想要一个梨，可是卖梨的人不给。

stories.title: 狼 · The Wolf

cards.title: 01. 晚归的屠夫 | The Butcher Heads Home
cards.sentence: 从前有个屠夫，每天傍晚卖完肉才回家。
cards.pinyin: Cóng qián yǒu gè tú fū，měi tiān bàng wǎn mài wán ròu cái huí jiā。
cards.translation: Once there was a butcher who went home only after selling his meat each evening.

cards.title: 02. 天黑上路 | Dark Road Home
cards.sentence: 这天，天快黑了，他挑着空担子往家走。
cards.pinyin: Zhè tiān，tiān kuài hēi le，tā tiāo zhe kōng dān zi wǎng jiā zǒu。
cards.translation: This day, as it grew dark, he walked home carrying an empty load on a pole.

cards.title: 03. 两狼尾随 | Two Wolves Follow
cards.sentence: 半路上，两只狼悄悄跟在他后面，走了很远。
cards.pinyin: Bàn lù shàng，liǎng zhī láng qiāo qiāo gēn zài tā hòu miàn，zǒu le hěn yuǎn。
cards.translation: On the way, two wolves quietly followed behind him for a long distance.

cards.title: 04. 扔骨吓狼 | Bones to the Wolves
cards.sentence: 屠夫很害怕，就把骨头扔给它们，想让它们停下。
cards.pinyin: Tú fū hěn hài pà，jiù bǎ gǔ tóu rēng gěi tā men，xiǎng ràng tā men tíng xià。
cards.translation: The butcher was scared and threw bones to them, hoping to make them stop.

cards.title: 05. 一停一跟 | One Stops, One Follows
cards.sentence: 一只狼停下吃骨头，另一只却还跟着他。
cards.pinyin: Yī zhī láng tíng xià chī gǔ tóu，lìng yī zhī què hái gēn zhe tā。
cards.translation: One wolf stopped to eat the bone, but the other kept following him.

cards.title: 06. 吃完又跟 | They Regroup
cards.sentence: 等他再扔骨头，先前的狼吃完又跟上来了。
cards.pinyin: Děng tā zài rēng gǔ tóu，xiān qián de láng chī wán yòu gēn shàng lái le。
cards.translation: When he threw more bones, the first wolf finished eating and followed again.

cards.title: 07. 骨尽狼随 | Out of Bones
cards.sentence: 骨头扔光了，两只狼还像原来一样一起跟着他。
cards.pinyin: Gǔ tóu rēng guāng le，liǎng zhī láng hái xiàng yuán lái yī yàng yī qǐ gēn zhe tā。
cards.translation: The bones were all thrown, yet both wolves still followed him together as before.

cards.title: 08. 前后夹击 | A Pincer Plan
cards.sentence: 屠夫心想：它们是要前后夹击我啊！
cards.pinyin: Tú fū xīn xiǎng：tā men shì yào qián hòu jiā jī wǒ a！
cards.translation: The butcher thought: they mean to attack me from front and back!

cards.title: 09. 背靠柴堆 | Back to the Brushwood
cards.sentence: 他看见路边有堆柴草，就跑过去背靠柴堆站着。
cards.pinyin: Tā kàn jiàn lù biān yǒu duī chái cǎo，jiù pǎo guò qù bèi kào chái duī zhàn zhe。
cards.translation: He saw a pile of brushwood by the road and ran to stand with his back against it.

cards.title: 10. 一睡一挖 | One Sleeps, One Digs
cards.sentence: 两只狼不敢靠近，一只假装睡觉，一只去柴堆下打洞。
cards.pinyin: Liǎng zhī láng bù gǎn kào jìn，yī zhī jiǎ zhuāng shuì jué，yī zhī qù chái duī xià dǎ dòng。
cards.translation: The two wolves dared not approach; one pretended to sleep, the other went to dig a hole under the pile.

cards.title: 11. 暴起杀狼 | He Strikes
cards.sentence: 屠夫突然跳起来，用刀杀死了那只打洞的狼。
cards.pinyin: Tú fū tū rán tiào qǐ lái，yòng dāo shā sǐ le nà zhǐ dǎ dòng de láng。
cards.translation: The butcher suddenly jumped up and killed the digging wolf with his knife.

cards.title: 12. 斩草除根 | The Second Wolf
cards.sentence: 他回头看，睡觉的狼也正要偷袭，也被他一刀结果了。
cards.pinyin: Tā huí tóu kàn，shuì jué de láng yě zhèng yào tōu xí，yě bèi tā yī dāo jié guǒ le。
cards.translation: He looked back; the sleeping wolf was about to sneak-attack, and was also finished off with one stroke.

stories.intro: A man walking home at dusk is followed by two wolves. A cool head is his only weapon.
stories.introZh: 天快黑了，两只狼一直跟着他。

stories.title: 聂小倩 · Nie Xiaoqian

cards.title: 01. 正直书生 | An Honest Scholar
cards.sentence: 书生宁采臣家里穷，但为人正直，从不贪心。
cards.pinyin: Shū shēng níng cǎi chén jiā lǐ qióng，dàn wèi rén zhèng zhí，cóng bù tān xīn。
cards.translation: The scholar Ning Caichen was poor but honest, and never greedy.

cards.title: 02. 古庙过夜 | A Night at the Temple
cards.sentence: 一天，他路过一座没有人住的古庙，决定进去过夜。
cards.pinyin: Yī tiān，tā lù guò yī zuò méi yǒu rén zhù de gǔ miào，jué dìng jìn qù guò yè。
cards.translation: One day, he passed an old temple where no one lived and decided to stay the night.

cards.title: 03. 夜访佳人 | A Girl at Midnight
cards.sentence: 半夜，一个美丽的姑娘走进他的房间，名叫聂小倩。
cards.pinyin: Bàn yè，yī gè měi lì de gū niáng zǒu jìn tā de fáng jiān，míng jiào niè xiǎo qiàn。
cards.translation: At midnight, a beautiful girl entered his room; her name was Nie Xiaoqian.

cards.title: 04. 温柔搭话 | A Gentle Approach
cards.sentence: 小倩笑着对他说：“我喜欢你，想和你做朋友。”
cards.pinyin: Xiǎo qiàn xiào zhe duì tā shuō：“wǒ xǐ huān nǐ，xiǎng hé nǐ zuò péng yǒu。”
cards.translation: Xiaoqian said with a smile, "I like you and want to be friends."

cards.title: 05. 不为所动 | He Resists
cards.sentence: 宁采臣知道夜里来的姑娘不简单，没有答应她。
cards.pinyin: Níng cǎi chén zhī dào yè lǐ lái de gū niáng bù jiǎn dān，méi yǒu dá yīng tā。
cards.translation: Ning knew a girl coming at night was not ordinary, and did not agree.

cards.title: 06. 自陈是鬼 | The Truth About Her
cards.sentence: 小倩叹了口气，说：“其实我是鬼，被妖怪逼着害你。”
cards.pinyin: Xiǎo qiàn tàn le kǒu qì，shuō：“qí shí wǒ shì guǐ，bèi yāo guài bī zhe hài nǐ。”
cards.translation: Xiaoqian sighed and said, "Actually I am a ghost, forced by a demon to harm you."

cards.title: 07. 好心提醒 | A Kind Warning
cards.sentence: 她好心提醒：“明天你一定要和房里的剑客做朋友。”
cards.pinyin: Tā hǎo xīn tí xǐng：“míng tiān nǐ yī dìng yào hé fáng lǐ de jiàn kè zuò péng yǒu。”
cards.translation: She kindly warned, "Tomorrow you must befriend the swordsman in the room."

cards.title: 08. 结交剑客 | Meeting Yan Chixia
cards.sentence: 第二天，宁采臣认识了那位叫燕赤霞的剑客，两人成了好朋友。
cards.pinyin: Dì èr tiān，níng cǎi chén rèn shí le nà wèi jiào yàn chì xiá de jiàn kè，liǎng rén chéng le hǎo péng yǒu。
cards.translation: The next day, Ning met the swordsman named Yan Chixia, and the two became good friends.

cards.title: 09. 剑斩妖魔 | The Demon Is Slain
cards.sentence: 夜里，妖怪来杀宁采臣，燕赤霞用宝剑把它打败了。
cards.pinyin: Yè lǐ，yāo guài lái shā níng cǎi chén，yàn chì xiá yòng bǎo jiàn bǎ tā dǎ bài le。
cards.translation: At night, the demon came to kill Ning, and Yan Chixia defeated it with his magic sword.

cards.title: 10. 托骨归乡 | Taking Her Bones Home
cards.sentence: 小倩得救了，她请求宁采臣把她的骨头带回故乡安葬。
cards.pinyin: Xiǎo qiàn dé jiù le，tā qǐng qiú níng cǎi chén bǎ tā de gǔ tóu dài huí gù xiāng ān zàng。
cards.translation: Xiaoqian was saved; she asked Ning to take her bones back to her hometown to bury.

cards.title: 11. 魂魄相随 | Her Spirit Follows
cards.sentence: 宁采臣答应了她，把骨头带回家，小倩的魂魄也跟着他。
cards.pinyin: Níng cǎi chén dá yīng le tā，bǎ gǔ tóu dài huí jiā，xiǎo qiàn de hún pò yě gēn zhe tā。
cards.translation: Ning agreed, took the bones home, and Xiaoqian's spirit followed him.

cards.title: 12. 幸福相守 | A Happy Home
cards.sentence: 后来，小倩在宁家安心生活，两人像家人一样幸福。
cards.pinyin: Hòu lái，xiǎo qiàn zài níng jiā ān xīn shēng huó，liǎng rén xiàng jiā rén yī yàng xìng fú。
cards.translation: Later, Xiaoqian lived peacefully in Ning's home, and the two were happy like family.

stories.intro: An honest scholar stays in an old temple and meets a ghost girl who begs for his help. A love story across two worlds.
stories.introZh: 一个好人在古庙里遇到了一个女鬼。

stories.title: 婴宁 · Ying Ning
stories.intro: A young scholar falls for a girl who laughs at everything. Behind her smile is a secret.
stories.introZh: 一个爱笑的女孩，有一个很大的秘密。

cards.title: 01. 春天出门 | A Spring Outing
cards.sentence: 春天到了，年轻人王子服出门去玩。
cards.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, niánqīngrén Wáng Zǐfú chūmén qù wán.
cards.translation: Spring arrived, and the young man Wang Zifu went out to have some fun.

cards.title: 02. 笑着的女孩 | A Smiling Girl
cards.sentence: 路上，他看见一个漂亮的女孩，手里拿着一朵花，对他笑了笑。
cards.pinyin: Lùshang, tā kànjiàn yí ge piàoliang de nǚhái, shǒu lǐ názhe yì duǒ huā, duì tā xiào le xiào.
cards.translation: On the road he saw a pretty girl with a flower in her hand. She smiled at him.

cards.title: 03. 掉下的花 | The Dropped Flower
cards.sentence: 女孩走远了，那朵花掉在地上，王子服把它捡了起来。
cards.pinyin: Nǚhái zǒu yuǎn le, nà duǒ huā diào zài dìshang, Wáng Zǐfú bǎ tā jiǎn le qǐlái.
cards.translation: The girl walked far away. The flower fell on the ground, and Wang Zifu picked it up.

cards.title: 04. 想病了 | Lovesick
cards.sentence: 回到家，他天天想那个女孩，吃不下，睡不好，最后生病了。
cards.pinyin: Huí dào jiā, tā tiāntiān xiǎng nà ge nǚhái, chī bu xià, shuì bu hǎo, zuìhòu shēngbìng le.
cards.translation: Back home, he thought about the girl every day. He couldn't eat or sleep well, and in the end he fell ill.

cards.title: 05. 表哥来了 | His Cousin Helps
cards.sentence: 表哥来看他，问清楚了原因，答应帮他去找那个女孩。
cards.pinyin: Biǎogē lái kàn tā, wèn qīngchu le yuányīn, dāying bāng tā qù zhǎo nà ge nǚhái.
cards.translation: His cousin came to see him, found out what was wrong, and promised to help him look for the girl.

cards.title: 06. 山里的村子 | A Village in the Hills
cards.sentence: 他们在山里的一个小村子里，又看见了那个爱笑的女孩。
cards.pinyin: Tāmen zài shān lǐ de yí ge xiǎo cūnzi lǐ, yòu kànjiàn le nà ge ài xiào de nǚhái.
cards.translation: In a small village in the hills, they saw the girl who loved to laugh once again.

cards.title: 07. 她叫婴宁 | Her Name Is Yingning
cards.sentence: 女孩说：“我叫婴宁，只有一位老妈妈照顾我。”
cards.pinyin: Nǚhái shuō: “Wǒ jiào Yīngníng, zhǐyǒu yí wèi lǎo māma zhàogù wǒ.”
cards.translation: The girl said, “My name is Yingning. Only an old lady takes care of me.”

cards.title: 08. 爱笑的新娘 | A Bride Who Laughs
cards.sentence: 结婚那天，婴宁一直笑个不停，大家也都笑了。
cards.pinyin: Jiéhūn nà tiān, Yīngníng yìzhí xiào ge bù tíng, dàjiā yě dōu xiào le.
cards.translation: On the wedding day, Yingning kept laughing and couldn't stop, and everyone laughed too.

cards.title: 09. 满院的花 | A Yard Full of Flowers
cards.sentence: 她最爱花，在院子里种了很多很多花。
cards.pinyin: Tā zuì ài huā, zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng le hěn duō hěn duō huā.
cards.translation: She loved flowers most of all and planted lots and lots of them in the yard.

cards.title: 10. 邻居的麻烦 | Trouble Next Door
cards.sentence: 邻居家的儿子想对婴宁做坏事，结果自己受伤了。
cards.pinyin: Línjū jiā de érzi xiǎng duì Yīngníng zuò huàishì, jiéguǒ zìjǐ shòushāng le.
cards.translation: The neighbor's son tried to do something bad to Yingning, and ended up getting hurt himself.

cards.title: 11. 说出秘密 | The Secret
cards.sentence: 婴宁哭着说出了秘密：她小时候，是一位鬼妈妈养大了她。
cards.pinyin: Yīngníng kūzhe shuōchū le mìmì: tā xiǎoshíhou, shì yí wèi guǐ māma yǎng dà le tā.
cards.translation: Crying, Yingning told her secret: when she was little, a ghost mother had raised her.

cards.title: 12. 回山安葬 | Going Home
cards.sentence: 王子服陪她回山里，安葬了鬼妈妈，后来他们一家人很幸福。
cards.pinyin: Wáng Zǐfú péi tā huí shān lǐ, ānzàng le guǐ māma, hòulái tāmen yì jiārén hěn xìngfú.
cards.translation: Wang Zifu went with her back to the hills and laid the ghost mother to rest. Afterwards, the family lived happily.

stories.title: 青凤 · Qing Feng
stories.intro: A brave young man moves into a haunted house and meets a fox girl. Kindness brings them together again.
stories.introZh: 他住进一座有鬼的房子，遇到了一位特别的姑娘。

cards.title: 01. 有鬼的大宅 | The Haunted House
cards.sentence: 耿去病家有一座大房子，很多年没有人敢住，说里面有鬼。
cards.pinyin: Gěng Qùbìng jiā yǒu yí zuò dà fángzi, hěn duō nián méiyǒu rén gǎn zhù, shuō lǐmiàn yǒu guǐ.
cards.translation: Geng Qubing's family had a big house that no one had dared to live in for many years. People said it had ghosts.

cards.title: 02. 夜里的声音 | Sounds at Night
cards.sentence: 耿去病不怕，一个人住进去，半夜听到房子里有说话的声音。
cards.pinyin: Gěng Qùbìng bú pà, yí ge rén zhù jìnqù, bànyè tīngdào fángzi lǐ yǒu shuōhuà de shēngyīn.
cards.translation: Geng Qubing wasn't afraid. He moved in alone, and in the middle of the night he heard voices in the house.

cards.title: 03. 院子里的姑娘 | A Girl in the Yard
cards.sentence: 一天晚上，他看见院子里有一位姑娘，正在看月亮。
cards.pinyin: Yì tiān wǎnshang, tā kànjiàn yuànzi lǐ yǒu yí wèi gūniang, zhèngzài kàn yuèliang.
cards.translation: One evening he saw a girl in the yard, looking at the moon.

cards.title: 04. 安静地看 | Watching Quietly
cards.sentence: 耿去病怕吓到她，就安静地站在旁边，看了很久。
cards.pinyin: Gěng Qùbìng pà xià dào tā, jiù ānjìng de zhàn zài pángbiān, kàn le hěn jiǔ.
cards.translation: Geng Qubing was afraid of scaring her, so he stood quietly nearby and watched for a long time.

cards.title: 05. 老人出现 | An Old Man Appears
cards.sentence: 突然，一位老人走了出来，生气地问：“你是谁？这里是我们的家！”
cards.pinyin: Tūrán, yí wèi lǎorén zǒu le chūlái, shēngqì de wèn: “Nǐ shì shéi? Zhèlǐ shì wǒmen de jiā!”
cards.translation: Suddenly an old man walked out and asked angrily, “Who are you? This is our home!”

cards.title: 06. 有礼貌的回答 | A Polite Answer
cards.sentence: 耿去病很有礼貌地说：“对不起，我不是坏人，只是喜欢这里。”
cards.pinyin: Gěng Qùbìng hěn yǒu lǐmào de shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bú shì huàirén, zhǐshì xǐhuan zhèlǐ.”
cards.translation: Geng Qubing said politely, “Sorry. I'm not a bad person. I just like it here.”

cards.title: 07. 狐狸一家 | A Family of Foxes
cards.sentence: 老人看了他很久，才说：“其实，我们是狐狸，在这里住了很多年。”
cards.pinyin: Lǎorén kàn le tā hěn jiǔ, cái shuō: “Qíshí, wǒmen shì húli, zài zhèlǐ zhù le hěn duō nián.”
cards.translation: The old man looked at him for a long time, then said, “Actually, we are foxes. We have lived here for many years.”

cards.title: 08. 搬走了 | Moving Away
cards.sentence: 老人怕有麻烦，第二天就带着青凤搬走了。
cards.pinyin: Lǎorén pà yǒu máfan, dì-èr tiān jiù dàizhe Qīngfèng bān zǒu le.
cards.translation: The old man worried about trouble, so the next day he took Qingfeng and moved away.

cards.title: 09. 想念青凤 | Missing Qingfeng
cards.sentence: 耿去病每天都想念青凤，常常一个人坐在院子里，不吃饭。
cards.pinyin: Gěng Qùbìng měi tiān dōu xiǎngniàn Qīngfèng, chángcháng yí ge rén zuò zài yuànzi lǐ, bù chī fàn.
cards.translation: Geng Qubing missed Qingfeng every day. He often sat alone in the yard and wouldn't eat.

cards.title: 10. 追赶 | The Chase
cards.sentence: 一天，他在外面看见一群狗在追一只小狐狸，小狐狸很害怕。
cards.pinyin: Yì tiān, tā zài wàimian kànjiàn yì qún gǒu zài zhuī yì zhī xiǎo húli, xiǎo húli hěn hàipà.
cards.translation: One day, outside, he saw a pack of dogs chasing a little fox. The little fox was terrified.

cards.title: 11. 救下小狐狸 | The Rescue
cards.sentence: 耿去病马上跑过去，把小狐狸抱了起来，大声赶走了那些狗。
cards.pinyin: Gěng Qùbìng mǎshàng pǎo guòqù, bǎ xiǎo húli bào le qǐlái, dàshēng gǎnzǒu le nàxiē gǒu.
cards.translation: Geng Qubing ran over at once, picked up the little fox, and shouted the dogs away.

cards.title: 12. 团圆 | Together Again
cards.sentence: 回到家，小狐狸变成了青凤，两人高兴地住在了一起。
cards.pinyin: Huí dào jiā, xiǎo húli biàn chéng le Qīngfèng, liǎng ge rén gāoxìng de zhù zài le yìqǐ.
cards.translation: Back home, the little fox turned into Qingfeng, and the two happily lived together.

stories.title: 狐嫁女 · The Fox's Wedding
stories.intro: On a rainy night, a young man stumbles into a fox family's wedding party. Good manners are repaid with kindness.
stories.introZh: 下雨的夜里，一个年轻人看到了狐狸的婚礼。

cards.title: 01. 雨夜 | A Rainy Night
cards.sentence: 下雨了，年轻人殷天官跑进一座旧房子里，在地上睡着了。
cards.pinyin: Xià yǔ le, niánqīngrén Yīn Tiānguān pǎo jìn yí zuò jiù fángzi lǐ, zài dìshang shuìzháo le.
cards.translation: It started to rain. The young man Yin Tianguan ran into an old house and fell asleep on the floor.

cards.title: 02. 半夜的灯光 | Lights in the Dark
cards.sentence: 半夜，他醒来了，看见房子里到处都是灯，非常亮。
cards.pinyin: Bànyè, tā xǐng lái le, kànjiàn fángzi lǐ dàochù dōu shì dēng, fēicháng liàng.
cards.translation: In the middle of the night he woke up and saw lamps everywhere in the house. It was very bright.

cards.title: 03. 客人来了 | Guests Arrive
cards.sentence: 很多客人来了，他们穿着漂亮的衣服，高兴地说着话。
cards.pinyin: Hěn duō kèrén lái le, tāmen chuānzhe piàoliang de yīfu, gāoxìng de shuōzhe huà.
cards.translation: Many guests arrived, dressed in beautiful clothes and chatting happily.

cards.title: 04. 今晚的喜事 | A Wedding Tonight
cards.sentence: 他听见有人说：“今天晚上，老爷的女儿要结婚了！”
cards.pinyin: Tā tīngjiàn yǒu rén shuō: “Jīntiān wǎnshang, lǎoye de nǚ'ér yào jiéhūn le!”
cards.translation: He heard someone say, “Tonight the master's daughter is getting married!”

cards.title: 05. 被发现了 | Found Out
cards.sentence: 他想悄悄走开，却被一个人发现了，那个人大声叫了起来。
cards.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qiāoqiāo zǒu kāi, què bèi yí ge rén fāxiàn le, nà ge rén dàshēng jiào le qǐlái.
cards.translation: He tried to slip away quietly, but someone spotted him and shouted out loud.

cards.title: 06. 主人的邀请 | An Invitation
cards.sentence: 房子的主人笑着说：“别怕，请留下来，喝一杯喜酒吧！”
cards.pinyin: Fángzi de zhǔrén xiàozhe shuō: “Bié pà, qǐng liú xiàlái, hē yì bēi xǐjiǔ ba!”
cards.translation: The master of the house said with a smile, “Don't be afraid. Please stay and have a cup of wedding wine!”

cards.title: 07. 热闹的婚礼 | A Lively Wedding
cards.sentence: 婚礼上又唱又跳，非常热闹，新娘低着头，一句话也不说。
cards.pinyin: Hūnlǐ shàng yòu chàng yòu tiào, fēicháng rènao, xīnniáng dī zhe tóu, yí jù huà yě bù shuō.
cards.translation: At the wedding there was singing and dancing, and it was very lively. The bride kept her head down and said not a word.

cards.title: 08. 一起喝酒 | Drinking Together
cards.sentence: 他喝了很多酒，觉得很开心，和大家一起聊天。
cards.pinyin: Tā hē le hěn duō jiǔ, juéde hěn kāixīn, hé dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān.
cards.translation: He drank a lot of wine, felt very happy, and chatted with everyone.

cards.title: 09. 送新娘 | The Bride Leaves
cards.sentence: 天快亮了，新娘上了车，大家一起送她出门。
cards.pinyin: Tiān kuài liàng le, xīnniáng shàng le chē, dàjiā yìqǐ sòng tā chūmén.
cards.translation: Dawn was near. The bride got into the carriage, and everyone saw her off at the door.

cards.title: 10. 一只金杯 | A Golden Cup
cards.sentence: 主人很感谢他，送给他一只金杯，说：“请收下吧！”
cards.pinyin: Zhǔrén hěn gǎnxiè tā, sòng gěi tā yì zhī jīnbēi, shuō: “Qǐng shōuxià ba!”
cards.translation: The master thanked him warmly and gave him a golden cup, saying, “Please accept it!”

cards.title: 11. 天亮以后 | At Daybreak
cards.sentence: 天亮了，旧房子里一个人也没有，只有金杯还在桌子上。
cards.pinyin: Tiān liàng le, jiù fángzi lǐ yí ge rén yě méiyǒu, zhǐyǒu jīnbēi hái zài zhuōzi shàng.
cards.translation: At daybreak there was no one in the old house. Only the golden cup was still on the table.

cards.title: 12. 狐狸朋友 | Fox Friends
cards.sentence: 后来，每次他遇到困难，都有人帮他，原来是那些狐狸朋友。
cards.pinyin: Hòulái, měi cì tā yùdào kùnnan, dōu yǒu rén bāng tā, yuánlái shì nàxiē húli péngyou.
cards.translation: Later, whenever he ran into difficulty, someone helped him. It turned out to be those fox friends.
